opening.argument: The structure presented here is built around sponsored business lines, multiple rows, a large team and internal leadership. The speaker describes, “I have sponsored is business line. We are 25 business rows. Is there 25 business lines? Total 20.000 people,” and adds that the team has “6 monster builders,” establishing a rank-based organization rather than an ordinary product offer. The income claims are extraordinary: “Every day you get 8 to 10 bitcoins in your income. One month, 300 bitcoins,” with 300 bitcoins identified as the highest salary. Those claims are presented positively alongside a persistent registration call to action directing viewers to a link below the video, joining recruitment structure, tiered leadership and exceptional Bitcoin earnings in one promotion.
